FedRAMP-authorized observability: Grafana Federal Cloud

Grafana Federal Cloud is a fully-managed, FedRAMP High Authorized, and DoD IL5 compliant observability solution that helps you quickly understand and improve the health and performance of your applications and infrastructure.

Why choose Grafana Federal Cloud

Built for federal agencies, SLED organizations, systems integrators, and software vendors, Grafana Federal Cloud provides strong data protection, compliance, and a best-in-class developer experience. Keep your software running smoothly with fully managed observability built for teams in regulated environments.

Enhanced security

Protect sensitive data with FedRAMP High and DoD IL5 compliance.

Faster compliance

Inherit pre-validated controls to reduce time and cost of FedRAMP authorization.

Unified view of your data

See metrics, logs, and traces from multiple systems in one place.

Real-time insights

Monitor and alert on system health, availability, and performance in real time.

Cost-effective solution

Get competitive pricing and flexible licensing options.

Expert help

Access dedicated support including 24/7 troubleshooting for major incidents.

Built for Public Sector teams and their tech partners
Federal Agencies

Get real-time visibility into systems in a FedRAMP High environment without the need to set up and operate your own observability tooling.

Software Vendors (ISVs, EdTech, GovTech)

Accelerate SaaS delivery to government customers by embedding FedRAMP-compliant observability — no custom build required.

SLED (State, Local, Education) Organizations

Securely monitor applications and infrastructure across departments, campuses, or municipalities.

Systems Integrators

Deliver faster by integrating FedRAMP-compliant observability into your government solutions..

Grafana Labs is a Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Observability Platforms
Ranked #1 in Vision

We believe this recognition reflects what we’ve built with Grafana Cloud – a fully managed, open, and composable observability platform organizations use to bring together diverse data sources and own their own observability strategies.

Certifications and Compliance

Grafana Federal Cloud meets high-assurance standards required by Public Sector teams. Read more about our commitment to data privacy and security on our compliance page.

FedRAMP

Grafana Federal Cloud is FedRAMP High Authorized and compliant with Impact Level 5 (IL5) requirements.

NATSEC100

Grafana is one of the top 100 vendors advancing national security through trusted technology.

ISO 27001

Certified through an independent audit for alignment with information security management best practices.

SOC 2 Type 2 Certification

Certified through an independent audit for secure, reliable operations with audited controls for data privacy and service delivery.

PCI Security Standards Council

Grafana Labs maintains PCI DSS compliance for secure handling of payment-related infrastructure.

GDPR

Read the General Data Protection Regulation Data Processor Agreement (DPA) for Grafana Labs.

Cloud Security Alliance (CSA)

Listed in the CSA STAR registry for transparency in security and data privacy.
